Can we just acknowledge how stressful moving to a new city is? Because nobody talks about it enough! Everyone's all like, "Oh, it'll be such an adventure!" Yeah, sure, an adventure in figuring out which grocery store isn't going to charge you nine dollars for a bag of apples. I moved three months ago and I still don't know where anything is. My GPS has become my best friend. Honestly, it's kind of embarrassing. I got lost going to the post office last week. The post office! It was literally two blocks away. And making friends as an adult? Don't even get me started. It's so awkward. You can't just go up to someone and be like, "Hey, want to hang out?" That's weird after age twelve. I've been going to this coffee shop every morning hoping the barista will eventually become my buddy. She knows my order now, so that's progress, right? Baby steps!
